why: The story describes a half-burned wax vesta found in the mud of the hollow.

text: Why was a match struck in the hollow?
why: Finding a burned match where Straker died plainly invites the question of why it was struck.

text: Why was a match struck in the hollow? — to light his pipe
why: Straker's pockets held a briar pipe, tobacco and a box of vestas, so lighting a pipe is an obvious possibility.

text: Why was a match struck in the hollow? — to light the candle for close work
id: q.why_light=to light the candle for close work
why: Straker carried a candle stub and a knife 'devised for very delicate work', so lighting the candle is a reasonable possibility. This is borderline: 'close work' leans toward a solution the story has not given.
